Elaine (PM): Quick sync — Q3 hosted inference roadmap. Need to lock slices for: chat streaming improvements, embeddings cost reductions for bulk jobs, and stricter rerank SLAs. We have customer asks that push different priorities; want to get alignment on must-have vs nice-to-have.
Mike (Eng): Streaming + KV cache optimizations are doable in a single sprint, but embeddings cost reduction will need quantization + smarter batching. Need a rough eng estimate before we promise customers.
Sanjay (Infra): For rerank SLA we should evaluate dedicated pools + autoscale tweaks. That buys lower p99 but costs reservations. Ballpark infra change: ~2 weeks to wire up autoscale policies and rollout controls.
Tina (Solutions): Customer A and Customer C both asked for cheaper embeddings at scale. Customer A said they'd commit if we can cut unit embedding cost ~30% for batch jobs. Customer C cares more about rerank latency for search.
Elaine (PM): Draft OKRs proposal: 
- OKR1: Reduce per-embedding unit cost by 30% for 90th percentile batch workloads (measured by cost/token).
- OKR2: Achieve rerank p99 < 150ms for top-tier customers under normal load.
- OKR3: Launch chat streaming beta with function-calling and stable streaming semantics.
Are these measurable/realistic?
Mike (Eng): We can measure embedding cost with token/op and end-to-end batch throughput numbers. Rerank p99 requires a fallback plan (smaller model or cached rerank) when overloaded. Proposed launch criteria: perf stability for 2 continuous weeks in staging, canary at 5% traffic, rollback threshold: error rate >0.5% or latency regression >20%.
Sanjay (Infra): Operational asks: add tracing tags for model_variant and route_id, and expose per-route cost breakdown in Console. Canary config we plan to use: 
```json
{"canary": {"percent": 5, "max_qps": 50}}
```
Tina (Solutions): Prioritization suggestion from field: 1) Rerank SLA for top 3 customers (they will pay for reserved capacity), 2) Embeddings cost improvements for batch workloads, 3) Chat streaming perf/UX improvements. I'll validate willingness-to-pay with sales.
Elaine (PM): Sounds reasonable. We should also call out non-goals: full-model distillation and multi-model ensemble for rerank this quarter. Those are high-effort.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled — infra-pack v2.1 -> staging tonight at 02:00 UTC.
Mike (Eng): Action items: 
- Eng to scope quantization + batching plan (owner: Mike) — due EOD Fri.
- Infra to size dedicated pools + canary policy (owner: Sanjay) — due Wed.
- Product + Solutions to confirm customer bets and committed revenue (owners: Elaine, Tina) — due Mon.
Elaine (PM): OK — I'll set a follow-up meeting Thu 09:00 to finalize slice assignments and I'll post a short PRD after that. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
